consular.mission: Canadian Embassy, Havana; Australian Embassy, Mexico City
consular.notes: Australia doesn't have an embassy in Cuba. The Embassy of Canada in Havana provides consular assistance to Australians in Cuba. They can also issue Australian provisional travel documents. You can also get consular assistance from the Australian Embassy in Mexico.
